stem: Two business customers buy the same laptop model. Both have a discount depth of 8%, but customer A's price realisation is 88% and customer B's is 81%. What explains the gap?

options.text: B's rebates after the invoice are a larger share of list value
B's discounts on the invoice are deeper than A's discounts
B's laptops cost Voltmarkt more to buy, which lowers its realisation
B bought fewer laptops, which lowers its price realisation
